BUSINESS STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Mombasa
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nakuru

2. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   C. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.

3. Which statement about Statement of Financial Position is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Statement of Financial Position as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Statement of Financial Position.
   C. Say Statement of Financial Position never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Statement of Financial Position with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Cash Flow Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Cash Flow Statement as rumours only.
   B. Say Cash Flow Statement never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Cash Flow Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Flow Statement.

5. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Hide all money underground

6. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.
   C. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.

7. Which statement about End - Of - Year Adjustments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain End - Of - Year Adjustments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat End - Of - Year Adjustments as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing End - Of - Year Adjustments.
   D. Say End - Of - Year Adjustments never happens in Kenya.

8. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.

9. Which statement about Networking in Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Networking in Business as rumours only.
   B. Explain Networking in Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Networking in Business.
   D. Say Networking in Business never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Insurance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Insurance as rumours only.
   B. Explain Insurance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Insurance.
   D. Say Insurance never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.
   C. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Marketing as rumours only.

12. Which statement about Income Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Income Statement as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Income Statement.
   C. Say Income Statement never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Income Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Entrepreneurship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Marketing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Income Statement and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Statement of Financial Position and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
